officialText:
Section 225.61 – Retitle the Informational Note in Section 225.61 “Informational Note No. 1” and add a new Informational Note at the end of Section 225.61 to read as follows:

Informational Note No. 2: The utility company’s requirements for vertical and horizontal clearance for overhead service conductors may be more stringent.
